bio:
Splitter4GPT takes a large text file and splits it into chunks small enough to paste into ChatGPT or another language model, cutting on sensible boundaries instead of mid-sentence. Drag a file in, get the pieces out.

Everything happens in your browser; nothing is uploaded. One page, no install. By Tront (Trent Sterling).
